findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The handler was changed from a concrete `DetectorHandler` with a stub `evaluate` to `StatefulDetectorHandler` with an empty body. `StatefulDetectorHandler` has abstract members: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. None are implemented here. `MetricAlertFire` is registered with this class as its `detector_handler`, so `Detector.detector_handler` raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class` for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire`. `process_detectors` would then crash instead of returning an empty result as it did before. Either keep the previous no-op handler or implement the abstract methods. The leftover `TODO: This will be a stateful detector` comment is also misleading now.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring still says it 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`'. The signature now returns a `dict` keyed by group key, so the documentation contradicts the contract this PR changed.
